Ever wanted a little more privacy when you're polishing your iridium eggplant? Look no further!

This mod allows you to place wood panels as dividers to partition rooms! As is, you can place things like the ceramic pillars or bookshelves to separate a room into sections, but that wasn't enough privacy for me. I need my own room inside of a room inside of my cellar inside of my house. Layers people, it's all about layers! 

Using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], a few lines of code in "Content\Data\Furniture.xnb" is replaced with my edited version which changes the panels from paintings to decorations. This lets you place panels in the middle of a room instead of only on walls like it is in vanilla Stardew Valley. I also widened the flat [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Wood_Panel]Wood Panel[/url]﻿ so that it doesn't have a gap on the left side and is the same size now as the two types of [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Log_Panel]Log Panel[/url]﻿. 
[/size][/font][font=Arial]
[color=#f1c232][size=3][u][b]Where To Get The Panels?:[/b][/u][/size][/color][font=Arial][size=2]
Not sure where the panels are in game? I can help!

[/size][/font][size=2]-All three panels are decorations now, not paintings, so they will show up in the bottom tab in the catalogue.[/size]

[size=2]-Don't have the catalogue yet? No worries! You can purchase the log panels (without or with the plant) from Pierre's stall for [img width=18,height=18]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/1/10/Gold.png/18px-Gold.png[/img]500g and [img width=18,height=18]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/1/10/Gold.png/18px-Gold.png[/img]700g respectively during the [/size][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Feast_of_the_Winter_Star]Feast of the Winter Star[/url][size=2]. There are 2 different variants of the [/size][url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Log_Panel]Log Panel[/url][size=2], one with a hanging plant and one without. The flat [/size][url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Wood_Panel]Wood Panel[/url][size=2] option is also available from Pierre's stall during the [/size][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Feast_of_the_Winter_Star]Feast of the Winter Star[/url][size=2] for [img width=18,height=18]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/1/10/Gold.png/18px-Gold.png[/img]500g.[/size]

[/font]

[color=#f1c232][b]1)[/b] [/color]Install and/or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

[color=#f1c232][b]3)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder (which contains the assets folder as well as, content.json, & manifest.json) into your "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this: "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Panels As Walls\assets"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size][font=Arial][size=2]
